Claude usage limit tips: 5 habits for free plan users. Limits reset every five hours.

1. Plan First - Plan your chat first for fewer back-and-forths.
2. Batch - Put several requests in one message.
3. Be Specific - Be clear and concise to avoid corrections.
4. Use Projects - Upload documents you reuse once, into a project.
5. Pick The Model - Choose a lighter model for simple jobs.
